photos.name: first-loaf-cross-score-cooling
photos.summary: First loaf cooling on a wire rack after bake, showing a cross score with strong oven spring and a deep golden-brown crust dusted with flour.

photos.name: first-loaf-cross-score-vsco
photos.summary: Both finished loaves on display: the cross-scored first loaf in the foreground on a plate and the decorative-scored second loaf cooling on a wire rack behind it, with paper bags in the background.

photos.name: second-loaf-mid-bake-challenger
photos.summary: Second loaf mid-bake in the Challenger bread pan with the lid removed, sitting on parchment paper inside the oven, with a decorative wheat-stalk score beginning to open along the surface.
